content.text:
I am writing to express my strong interest in the
position. As a Computer Science student from
Northeastern University with research experience
at Harvard SEAS, I believe my technical skills and
problem-solving abilities align well with your team's
needs.

During my research internship at Harvard SEAS, I
developed and optimized a high-performance data
processing system and designed and implemented
a cross-platform visualization application for real-
time data analysis, demonstrating my ability to
create robust, user-centric software solutions. This
experience honed my skills in system architecture
design, performance optimization, and full-stack
development.

I believe the internship experience will be an
excellent opportunity for me to apply all my
academic knowledge and also to improve my soft-
power skills by working with top practitioners in the
industry. Thank you for considering my application.
